name: bug-enrichment-golden
description: Golden set for Tier 3 judge calibration: twelve enriched bug reports of deliberately varied quality, each with a human overall score in labels.json. No deterministic checks: this set exists to measure judge-vs-human agreement, not to gate outputs.

criteria.name: correctness
criteria.description: Severity and reproduction steps match the defect actually described in the raw report.

criteria.name: completeness
criteria.description: Title, severity, and reproduction steps are all populated with usable content.

criteria.name: clarity
criteria.description: Reproduction steps are unambiguous and follow Given/When/Then form.
